    About

    Taiki Inomata, a third-year junior high student at the sports-centric Eimei Academy, attends early morning badminton practices only to consistently arrive second to his senior crush and rising basketball star, Chinatsu Kano. Despite the wide gap in their popularity and athletic standing, an unexpected twist of fate brings them even closer when Chinatsu moves in to live with Taiki's family. Determined to become a worthy match for his new housemate, Taiki intensifies his training with the shared dream of reaching the Nationals, all while striving to build a deeper relationship with her.
